groups.title: Message Queue Fundamentals
groups.question: Explain why an API would send work to a queue instead of doing it during the request, and how that is set up.

followUps.Why Queues — Decoupling, Retries & Backp: Sending a welcome email makes sign-up slow. How does a queue fix that?
followUps.BullMQ — Queues, Jobs & Workers: What are the producer, the queue and the worker in BullMQ, and why run workers separately?

groups.title: Reliability Patterns
groups.question: Explain how you make background jobs survive failures without doing harm.

followUps.Retries, Exponential Backoff & Dead-Lett: Why wait longer between each retry, and where does a job go when it keeps failing?
followUps.Job Idempotency: A job that charges a card runs twice after a retry. How do you make that safe?

groups.title: Webhooks
groups.question: Explain how webhooks work, both when your API sends them and when it receives them.

followUps.Sending Webhooks — Delivery Guarantees &: The receiver is down when you send a webhook. What should your system do?
followUps.Receiving Webhooks — HMAC Signature Veri: How does an HMAC signature prove a webhook really came from the sender?

groups.title: Scheduled & Delayed Jobs
groups.question: Explain how you would run jobs later or on a schedule, and keep an eye on your queues.

followUps.Delayed Jobs & Cron Scheduling with Bull: Why is setInterval a bad scheduler when your API runs as several processes?
followUps.Monitoring Queues — BullBoard: Which queue numbers would warn you that workers are falling behind?
